capabilities: Calculate ability modifiers and proficiency bonuses automatically
Roll dice and checks from the sheet
Track hit points, spell slots and class resources
extras: Written in Portuguese. Not yet in the community catalog, so installation is manual. Bundles 319 SRD 5.1 spells with a third-party Portuguese translation whose licensing the README says is still unconfirmed. The README warns to back up the vault before running the batch migration command.
motivation: The author wanted to gather tools for creating and managing characters, creatures, spells and game resources in one place, keeping the data in Obsidian's own files, for both game preparation and play.
problem: D&D 5e players and dungeon masters have no way to keep character sheets, spells and class resources as editable notes inside the vault.

relations.evidence: Integração com o Atlas VTT para abrir fichas associadas a notas e tokens.
Importação e exportação de blocos de estatísticas no formato Homebrewery.

summary: Plugin that turns D&D 5e character and creature sheets into editable vault files with automatic modifiers, dice rolls and spell tracking.
